strings.title: Friendly Percents as Fractions
strings.label: Bank
strings.strategy: Common percents have fraction partners: 25% is 1/4, 12.5% is 1/8, 20% is 1/5. Use the fraction to find the percent of a number in your head.
strings.keywords: percent, fraction, equivalent, one quarter, one eighth, one fifth, benchmark
watchFor: Treating 12.5% as 1/12: ask "What is half of 25%? Half of a quarter?"
Finding 75% by dividing by 75: ask "What fraction is 75%?"
Forgetting the build-up (37.5% = 3 × 12.5%): ask "How many eighths is 37.5%?"
strings.wrapUp: Ask "Which fraction did each percent remind you of?" Land: 50% = 1/2, 25% = 1/4, 12.5% = 1/8, 20% = 1/5, 10% = 1/10. Find one part, then build up.

problems.notes: Look for: a quarter of 48. Ask: "What fraction is 25%?" Word choice: "one quarter of". Model: bar 1/4 of 48

responses.say: 25% is a quarter, and a quarter of 48 is 12.
Half of 48 is 24, half again is 12.

problems.notes: Look for: three quarters: 3 × 12, or 48 − 12. Ask: "How does 25% help?" Model: ratio 100:48, 25:12, 75:36

responses.tip: Divided by the percent. Ask: what fraction is 75%?

problems.notes: Look for: half of 25%, an eighth. Ask: "What is half of a quarter?" Model: ratio 100:48, 25:12, 12.5:6

responses.say: Half of 12 is 6. 12.5% is an eighth.

responses.tip: Ask: is 12.5% one twelfth, or half of 25%?

problems.notes: Look for: 3 eighths: 3 × 6, or 25% + 12.5%. Ask: "Which two parts add to 37.5%?" Model: ratio 100:48, 12.5:6, 25:12, 37.5:18
Look for: a fifth of 35. Ask: "What fraction is 20%?" Model: bar 1/5 of 35
Look for: 3 fifths: 3 × 7. Ask: "How does 20% help?" Model: bar 3/5 of 35

responses.tip: Ask: should 60% of 35 be more than half of 35?

problems.notes: Look for: 0.4 is 40%, 2 fifths. Ask: "What percent is 0.4?" Model: bar 2/5 of 35

responses.tip: Decimal, percent and fraction all at once.
